title: epipactis moratoria
intro: Epipactis moratoria, commonly known as the rare and endangered Helleborine orchid, is a species of orchid native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, providing potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Epipactis moratoria are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. However, due to the limited research on this plant, more studies are needed to fully understand its health benefits and therapeutic applications.
